items.title: Marvell Technology Stocks Surge 12.22% as AI Optics Rally Eases Lumentum Deal Doubts
items.summary: Marvell shares recover part of their post-deal slide as investors revisit the $115 billion AI connectivity bet.

items.title: Credo Technology Stocks Climb 10.8% as AI Connectivity Names Rally
items.summary: Credo guided October-quarter revenue to $525 million to $535 million after a 115% jump in its previous quarter.

items.title: Coherent Stocks Climb 11.5% as Datacenter Optics Demand Lifts AI Suppliers
items.summary: Coherent's datacenter and communications sales jumped to $1.95 billion, and guidance points to up to $2.75 billion next quarter.

items.title: Sandisk Stocks Jump 16% as Storage Rally Returns Ahead of 8-for-1 Split
items.summary: Sandisk rebounds after a roughly 41% monthly drop, backed by guidance of up to $12.6 billion in quarterly revenue.

items.title: History Says This Is What Will Happen to Sandisk Stock After Its 8-for-1 Split
items.summary: Sandisk recently announced an 8-for-1 stock split.

items.title: SNDK Stock Set For Best Day In Nearly Four Months: Evercore ISI Forecasts Stable Demand For NAND Storage Amid AI Spending
items.summary: Evercore ISI kept a $2,500 price target on SanDisk stock, implying a potential surge of almost 200% from Tuesday's closing price.

items.title: Is the Micron Sell-Off a Buying Opportunity or a Falling Knife?
items.summary: The memory hardware industry is cyclical, and there are concerns that the cycle may be at its peak.

items.title: CoreWeave Rallies, Lifting Cloud and Chip Stocks
